scenes.title: The Silent Bell
scenes.card: The festival bell vanishes hours before sunset, and a trail of clues leads a village search party to a surprising gift.

scenes.title: The empty stand
scenes.card: The festival bell has vanished from its stand. It must ring at sunset.

subtitles.text: Marta: Hugo! The festival bell is gone!
Mayor Hugo: Gone? It must ring at sunset. That is five hours away!
Bea: There are wheel tracks in the dust. Big ones.
Mayor Hugo: Then everyone looks. Everyone!

scenes.title: Splitting up
scenes.card: The mayor sends the villagers to search the harbour and the market.

subtitles.text: Mayor Hugo: Finn, search the harbour. Lulu, the market. Marta and I will ask around here.
Finn: Aye. A bell cannot hide from a fisherman.
Lulu: I will look carefully. I always do.

scenes.title: Clue one: the harbour
scenes.card: At the harbour, Finn and Bea find deep wheel marks leading toward the smithy.

subtitles.text: Finn: No bell in the boats. No bell in the nets. Only fish.
Bea: Finn, look! Wheel marks. Deep ones, like something heavy.
Finn: Heavy and heading up the hill road. Toward the smithy!

scenes.title: Clue two: the painting
scenes.card: Lulu’s painting shows a covered cart belonging to Otto the blacksmith.

subtitles.text: Lulu: I painted the square at dawn. Look what is in the corner.
Marta: A cart. With a big shape under a blanket.
Mayor Hugo: Whose cart is that?
Lulu: Otto the blacksmith. He rolled it up the hill road before breakfast.

scenes.title: To the smithy
scenes.card: The search party marches to the smithy. The mayor thinks Otto took the bell.

subtitles.text: Mayor Hugo: The blacksmith hates noise. He took the bell to silence it!
Marta: Otto would never.
Finn: We will see. The smithy is just over the hill.

hud.text: Follow the clues to the smithy

scenes.title: The smithy
scenes.card: In the smithy, Otto reveals he secretly mended the cracked bell as a gift.

subtitles.text: Mayor Hugo: Otto! You took our festival bell!
Otto: It cracked at the last festival. I mended it at dawn. A gift. I wanted no fuss.
Marta: Otto. It is perfect.
Mayor Hugo: Ahem. I may have shouted a little too early.

scenes.title: Bringing it home
scenes.card: Otto carries the mended bell back to the village square.

subtitles.text: Bea: Careful, Otto. It rings if you sneeze.
Otto: I never sneeze.

scenes.title: The bell rings
scenes.card: The bell is back on its stand and rings at sunset.

subtitles.text: Mayor Hugo: Citizens of the village! The festival bell rings again!

scenes.title: Festival night
scenes.card: The village celebrates with a feast. Otto is thanked.

subtitles.text: Marta: Otto, the first dance is yours. And the first bowl of soup.
Otto: I do not dance. But I will take the soup.
Mayor Hugo: From now on, the smithy is not the quiet house. It is the house of the bell.
Bea: Next year I will ring it myself!
